reviews.text: Golden Gate Park is very large.  We visited in our car and were able to park in the areas we wanted to stop.  At Stowe Lake you can rent pedal boats or tow boats.  We rented a pedal boat for just under $30/hour.  We also visited the Bison area.  The Bison were hard to see and were off in the distance.  The park would be a great place for a picnic.

reviews.title: Nice place to visit
reviews.text: Do at least tour around the park.  The DeYoung is really great.  Science Museum had a lot of kids but looked interesting.  Dress in layers.

reviews.title: Great place to walk around on a sunny day
reviews.text: We went to the Golden Gate Park looking for some cheap activity in SF. We had a great day: Jazz music and dance, Golden Gate Park Brass band, Scottish dance, playground, pedalo, street food and lovely nature. The park is beautiful and well kept.

reviews.title: Could easily spend more time here
reviews.text: We were just walking on the outskirts of the park but it was still really peaceful and such a pleasant walk.. We know that we could have easily gone back and spent hours here including going to the museums etc in the park.   If you have the time lock down a day and head over here.

reviews.title: Roses are incredible!! Park is amazing
reviews.text: You can spend hours over there and never get bored! It so relaxing, perfect for a picnic! I really enjoyed!

reviews.title: Beautiful park
reviews.text: This park is a must see! We didn’t have enough time to see the whole park, but what we saw was beautiful. There’s much to do- walk around, ride a bike, visit museums (de Young Museum) and the Japanese Tea Garden, enjoy the lovely flowers at the Conservatory of Flowers and the list goes on... We were lucky to go to the park on a warm sunny day and enjoy the sights. Next time, we will definitely stay longer.

reviews.title: Worth the visit
reviews.text: Japanese tea gardens were beautiful. The park is very large and you might want to get a bike or other type of transportation to see. it all. The rose garden was beautiful as well. They also have bison in the park that are kept behind a fence. If you are lucky they may be at the front where you can catch a glimpse. Lovely place to have a picnic and just relax.

reviews.title: It's no Central park
reviews.text: We hired bikes and rode from Union Square with Golden Gate Park as our destination. I was really excited as I'd heard the park was better than Central Park, NY. SF is hilly of course and the ride was quite hard work. I've ridden bikes through NY's central park before and thought this would be similar - once in the park riding on wide, open bike paths with easy stops at each attraction. That was not the case. Once in the Park, you are actually riding on busy city roads, still with quite the uphill slopes. The attractions to visit once in the park were all expensive to enter. The Japanese gardens are a rip off. Do not bother paying $9 to visit these - they should be free. We did the park and I don't regret it, but it's not at the top of my SF to do list

reviews.title: Japanese tea garden/bikes
reviews.text: Only got to see a small area, but the park is well worth a visit, and easy to get to by public transport (bus from Haight Ashbury took about 10 minutes).Small entry fee to the Japanese garden, but there's a lovely tea room inside, and an amazing calm over the whole place, even when full of people. The large statue of the Buddha was particularly memorable.Big mistake was hiring a Surrey for an hour, imagining a leisurely cycle - two relatively fit middle aged people we had trouble making the thing move at all - no gears, and so heavy it wanted to roll back on the slighted slope.

reviews.title: Huge park !
reviews.text: Escape the city bustle in this enormous space of trees and grassy play areas. Beautifully manicured gardens (Japanese tea gardens are $9 per adult for a non-resident, so didn’t bother). Several museums.  We rented bikes on Fulton Street and enjoyed a meander through the parks many trails and roads.

reviews.title: LOTS TO SEE, LOTS to do!
reviews.text: This is a whole day thing.  There is so much to see and something for everyone.  SUNDAY in the park is amazing.  It will take more than a day to see it all so pace yourself.Don't miss the fast merry go round and play park if you have kids.  The arboretum is a place to unwind, I think there is more oxygen in the air in there.  always fun to see what's at the deyoung.  Ever changing groups of entertaining people watching.Don't miss the Japanese garden and have a bit of tea under the Ginko tree!

reviews.title: Golden gate park
reviews.text: This is a must . Lots of activities. We walked around the gardens . Heard a band play . Went to the botanical gardens and the De Young museum . We had tea at the Japanese tea garden

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: A very Nice area with Lots of beautiful Spots to discover - nature to explore and to lay back - good for a walk

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: Spent a gorgeous day in the park. Beautiful park so well planned and laid out. Nicer than Central Park in New York!

reviews.title: Hard to have a bad day at Golden Gate Park
reviews.text: There are so many things to do here, there are really two ways to do it.  First, meticulously plan your trip making sure you head to your number one priority immediately, followed by other activities in order.  Second, pick a spot and just start exploring.  I personally like the other way.  This most recent trip we started near where the 1 passes through the park.  We came to StowLake first and walked around it then crossed the bridge to the middle and climbed up to the top of Strawberry Hill.  TREMENDOUS views on a sunny day, when it had been foggy 45 minutes before.  Hit the Golden Gate Pavillion on the way down, then went into the Richmond district for lunch.  AWESOME day -- 90% by chance.  You could have 100 different adventures in this park, if only you had that much time.

reviews.title: Lots of options
reviews.text: The park is big with a lot of options to do various things. It's worth walking around for an afternoon- you won't be bored.

reviews.title: Great walking park.
reviews.text: This place is huge. We talked the pa hamdle.and a little bit of the park. It is a great place lots of people on bikes, jogging, walking, or just laying around. This place was a great way to spend some time on our Sunday!

reviews.title: loveyly
reviews.text: beautiful central park of San Francisco....   We enjoyed it and the museum of natural history nearby ...

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: What a wonderful Park so much to see and do. Families and friends playing baseball having bbq’s plus lots of walks. Passing a lovely relaxing trip on a family peddalo was fantastic with everybody shouting a greeting to each other.

reviews.title: Family time
reviews.text: My son took us to this amazing park where there is a building where you can take the lift to the top and see amazing views over San Francisco. There are many parts to this park and the Japanese garden is great. We managed to park in the underground car park.

reviews.title: Lots to see in the park
reviews.text: We visited the DeYoung museum, Windmill, AIDS Memorial Garden, Shakespeare Gardens, and the iconic Japanese Tea Gardens. It was a splendid day and the weather was beautiful, even after a chilly start in the morning.

reviews.title: Good to walk around
reviews.text: This place is very beautiful to walk around and enjoy the beauty of it. There has been a lot of car break-ins lately.

reviews.title: This park is a gem in the franticness (word?) of SF....
reviews.text: After usually a couple of days of running, and traffic, and panhandlers, and etc etc,  I trek west towards the park and get lost in everything that is there.  So much to do, and there's just something about laying down a blanket and just people watching.  Priceless.

reviews.title: Gorgeous and Peaceful Surroundings
reviews.text: I could have explored this Park all day. So much to see and everything within close proximity. Beautiful  museums, great Cafe nearby and the outdoor art was serene and lovely to look at. Lots to see which merits another visit by me!

reviews.title: Simply Beautiful
reviews.text: My family and I went to the California Science Academy and it was fun. W would have liked to have had time to visit more of the park, but time didn't permit. We really wanted to see the Japanese tea garden. The science academy has a 4 story rain forest, exhibits, and lots of space stuff (planetarium). The Golden Gate Park is definitely worth a trip to San Francisco.

reviews.title: Incredible Nature in the middle of the city
reviews.text: Nature fan? Peaceful and gorgeous place to walk around. Makes you forget the hurry of the city, the noise anth the traffic!!! Get in the Botanical Garden, get lost in between wonders of nature. Flowers, ancient plants, rain forest, easy to walk paths. Afterwards, take a walk around the Stow Lake. Get in the fabulous Japanese Tea Garden. then walk to fe Consevatory of Flowers. Worths enough!!!And please don’t forget comfortable shoes!!!

reviews.title: Something for everyone.
reviews.text: GG Park is a vast green haven of nature and serenity away from the concrete jungle of San Francisco. We were here to visit the Academy of Sciences but the Park is organized for folks to do a lot of activities here: Japanese Tea Garden, de Young art Museum, playgrounds and carousel for the kids, buffalo paddock, boat rentals, dog runs, etc. It's a great place to explore, relax, and/or have a picnic, although there are cafes in the main attractions. We only glimpsed 1/6 of the Park but saw tours on Segways which would be a fun way to see everything. It is free to walk through but some of the venues are not free, depending on the time and year, so do your homework. A very different neighbourhood of SF that I recommend to visit over a couple of days.

reviews.title: Segwaying through the park
reviews.text: What a gem to have such an amazing Park in the middle of such a huge City. My daughter and I did a Segway tour with the electric tour company through the park. It was so fun. Taking a kid on a Segway for the first time in the park was nice because I didn't have to worry about her getting hit by a car. Everything is flowering. Renting a bike or a Segway was a great way to see more of the park in a short time. I can imagine walking every day in the park if you were a local and still only experiencing part of it. What a cool place to take the kids to play. Or go on a picnic. Or hike... I have been to San Francisco many times and this was my first time going to the park and I would recommend it to anyone who needs a little nature

reviews.title: Great Place to Gather
reviews.text: Golden Gate Park offers so much to the residents and travelers to San Francisco. There are lakes to sit beside and enjoy the serenity of drifting waters, a lovely Arboretum, where many a wedding and engagement has served couples well, the site of many world famous musicians and singers coming together for a concert, rolling lawns to play on, picnic on, and just spread out a blanket and dream on. The Park has an interesting history worth looking up. Legend has it Mr McLaren, in his lifetime, used go into the park in the dead of night and hack at the roads so they made people travel slowly to enjoy the trees rather than just use it as a quick way from the Richmond District to the Sunset District or vice versa. It was also the place of the first BE IN and the Summer of Love (that has certainly been romanticized over the years).

reviews.title: Wonderful Park
reviews.text: We visited primarily to see the classic and historical 100 plus year old carousel. Wonderful park and wel wor a visit.

reviews.title: A day well spent at Golden Gate Park - San Francisco
reviews.text: We first visited the Japanese gardens, which is a very quite and green place, there is entrance fee...very manageable with kids or senior citizens, has a gift shop and a cafeteria too, serving very nice sandwiches, green tea, steamed edemame, besides other snacks.. There are many spots for good photography.There are 1-2 food trucks in the park little distance from the Japanese gardens.  We didn’t go the science museum, but it’s very good if you have school going kids. We visited the conservatory, which was delightful place full of exotic species of plants including many varieties of orchids. They also sell seeds, planters etc. On a summer day, you can walk around.. the entire park area..very good place to spend the day with family or friends

reviews.title: A glorious escape from the bustle of the city.
reviews.text: This is a must, and such a great contrast to the streets of San Francisco.  We were spoilt by the glorious sunshine and could have stayed hours longer than we did, as there was so much to see.

reviews.title: Far
reviews.text: It is really a park with nothing special it is only because is in San Francisco if not no interest at all

reviews.title: Central Park of the West
reviews.text: This did not come up high in our plans, but it was part of our Vantigo tour.  In fact we spent a great deal of time going through the park.  It is a very family oriented park for the locals.  Hike any where, no trail restrictions.  Well worth it if you have time.

reviews.title: A Green Oasis Amist the Concrete of the City
reviews.text: This is one of the great urban parks in the United States that has something for everyone.  It's definitely worth a visit to escape the urban crawl of San Francisco, as wonderful as it is.  If the weather is good, visit the SF Botanical Garden, which features twenty-one gardens of wonderful specimen plantings from around the world.  The Japanese Tea Garden is also intriguing with its strictly Asian theme, and you'll feel like you've been transported in the blink of an eye to Kyoto.  Save the de Young Museum and the California Academy of Sciences for inclement weather days.  The de Young Museum is home to an intriguing collection of American Art. Along with collections from Central and South America, Oceania and Africa it is a delight to explore.  On the first Tuesday of every month general admission is free at the de Young Museum.  The California Academy of Sciences offers state of the art science  installations and inter-active exhibits under its "Living Roof". There is definitely something for everyone here with a 900 species aquarium, planetarium, four-story living rain forest, and natural history museum. If you are with kids, plan on never leaving:)

reviews.title: Wish we had picked another day!
reviews.text: We viewed the Golden Gate park on the same day a triathlon was happening.  So we sadly didn't get to see much of the park.  There was supposed to be a shuttle running every 15 minutes, but we waited for a long time with no shuttle.On typical weekends, there is free parking at Ocean Beach, with a shuttle every 15 minutes to various stops in the park. For us, the kids got tired and barely made it to the windmill.  Hint: Go to the bathroom at the beach chalet and visitor center--bathrooms are sparse in the park!

reviews.title: Exploring the Park and Smelling the Flowers
reviews.text: There are so many trails to walk or run! They are well maintained and most are paved. A great place to get outside in the middle of the city and just smell the roses. Stop by the Dutch windmill and the waterfalls for a nice romantic time with a lover. Bring some water and wear comfortable shoes!

reviews.title: Delightful and safe walking park
reviews.text: We spent the good part of a day wandering this lovely park.  Many things to see and experience.  Make time to see the National AIDS Memorial Grove.  Quiet and absolutely stunning it’s variety of plant life, places to sit and remember, even participate in yoga.  The grove requires quiet reverence and with good reason.  You can also visit the Japanese garden and larger gardens directly across the road.  It’s easy to walk, but signs are sparse.  Use your google maps to help you meander the park.  Parking is limited, but we walked in and Uber’d out.  Easy. The park is worth your time, a mini Central Park on the west coast.

reviews.title: Great urban park
reviews.text: The crown jewel of the San Francisco park system and one of the great urban parks in the world. Wonderful to visit on weekends when a portion of the park is closed to car traffic and your bicycle around the park easily. Home of the outstanding botanical gardens, flower conservatory, de Young Museum, Japanese tea garden and California Academy of Sciences.

reviews.title: Lovely park
reviews.text: Stopped here on a tour round San Francisco did not get long about 30minutes . Stopped long enough to get a hot dog a must when you visit the USA. Would have been nice to spend more time but what I seen from the drive round was nice

reviews.title: Way too much to see here
reviews.text: We only did a really small section of the park near the lake.  We took a walk around it and there were model power boat (really impressively done), lots of ducks for the kids to chase, a well maintained walkway, an even terrapins.  We spent a good hour here just wandering about the place.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Golden gate park is incredible and definitely worth a visit allow at least a day, more if you intend to visit the museum there as that’s an event in its self, the park has a park with in itself as it’s laid out with many different designs and areas to explore, bring a picnic lunch although there is food available

reviews.title: Beautiful Scenery and a lot to do
reviews.text: Great place for walks, biking and to visit the two wonderful museums that are in the site. Lots of walking trails and peaceful environment.

reviews.title: Shuttle bus is a life-saver!
reviews.text: On a very hot day we walked and tried to find a second Electric scooter (which is gps operated and you pay with your phone etc). Anyhow we couldn’t find a 2nd one and caught the shuttle which is free and takes you to main route MUNI buses etc.  Buying a muni bus/streetcar pass in advance saved us a significant amount over 3 days!

reviews.title: Wonderful thing to have in a big city
reviews.text: We were in town for a SF baseball game.  We had time to go here and drive around and through it.  There are a lot of things in the park.  I think it is a wonderful thing to have this type of place in a big city.  There were many runners and bikers.

reviews.title: MAGNIFICIENT
reviews.text: How could one park hold so much variety of entertainment . ?You ould spend days just here.Science academy, planetarium, flower conservatorium,Japanese gardens. trails that feel like your in the remote countryside, rather than a city @! GO THERE!tHE HIGHLIGHT OF MY SHORT VISIT TO SAN FRANCISCO.

reviews.title: Beautiful park in the middle of the city.
reviews.text: The park is huge and has a lot of attractions.  A few museums, game fields, outdoor music, gardens.   I didn’t see where Kirk and crew landed their ship.

reviews.title: Antique Dutch windmill
reviews.text: Golden Gate Park really is an asthetically pleasing design found in a huge city.  There is a good model at a restaurant on the beach.  Some of the attractions are:  Japanese Tea Garden, California Academy of Sciences, and a couple of antique windmills.  When the park was first built near the beach, it was built on sand.  Grass had to be grown and irrigation was needed.  There is an antique Dutch windmill at the end closest to the Pacific Ocean beach.  Dutch windmills were only capable of bringing water to the surface from 17 feet or less.  These windmills must have been very important.

reviews.title: Definitely check it out
reviews.text: Definitely worth a visit if you come to San Francisco. Very beautiful park, and went on a Thursday so it wasn't to busy! There is so much to see and everything is so lush it's beautiful!

reviews.title: It's a park, a nice park but just a park
reviews.text: We were recommended a visit by all the locals. I would say, visit if you run out of things to do otherwise go to the park when you get back home. It is nothing special as parks go. Also, most of the bits you want to go into charge entry and are quite expensive.

reviews.title: Beautiful park!
reviews.text: A lovely and picturesque park.  Enjoyed the Japanese Tea Garden within the park and the little eatery they had there that was quite cozy.

reviews.title: Loved wandering around this park on scooters!
reviews.text: This pretty large park was so pretty and had so many fun things hidden in it! We really enjoyed meandering through it on our electric scooters!

reviews.title: Beautiful Place to Spend the Day
reviews.text: This park is huge.  If you plan to visit the entire park, I would recommend renting a bike, doing a segway tour, or  taking a rickshaw through it.  In the park you'll find the De Young Museum, the Academy of Sciences, the Japanese Tea Gardens, the Conservatory of Flowers, the botanical gardens, the rose gardens, and so much more.  A good majority of the attractions in the park require a fee to enter, but you can still enjoy it without needing to pay.  There are statues scattered throughout the park and countless walking paths through the trees.  You could spend an entire day in the park.

reviews.title: So Much to See and Do
reviews.text: Like Central Park in NYC, Golden Gate Park offers so much that the problem becomes deciding what to do in a limited time. Of course, there is plenty to see just walking though the park. We visited the Japanese Gardens (fee) and the Conservatory of Flowers (fee) but there are plenty of other cool things to do. It's well worth the time, and more time the better.

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: I live in San Francisco and love Golden Gate Park! You really cannot go wrong; there are so many cool spots to check out! It's beautiful just to walk or jog through the park but if you have more time to explore there is a lot to do. You can go to Stow Lake and rent little boats to row/paddle around. The observation tower at the De Young museum for free and get a spectacular view of the city. In my opinion, it is worth it to pay the entrance fee for the Japanese Tea Garden. Hippie Hill is also a fun place to bring a blanket and have a picnic on Sunday afternoons and enjoy the drum circle. For kids, the Korbet Children's Playground is awesome. If you head further west toward the ocean, you can see the buffalo paddock.

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: Got there by public transport, bus drivers and locals very helpful. The park has something for everyone, walking, botanical garden, Japanese garden, museums etc. Lovely place.

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I had no idea the park was so beautiful. We had not planned to go there, but went through it on the love tour and so glad we did. It is larger than Central Park in NYC & so diverse.

reviews.title: Don´t miss it
reviews.text: Full of attractions for people of any age. Go early in the morning to have a chance to explore it in its entirety.

reviews.title: Bigger than Central Park
reviews.text: So much to see in Golden Gate Park - the Japanese Garden, the DeYoung Museum, the Rose Garden, the herd of Bison! There are wild areas, and formal areas, and miles that you can walk. We have to go back, and explore more!

reviews.title: A park with a range of activities
reviews.text: This park spread over a very large area offers a range of sights and places to visit like San Francisco botanical Gardens, Japanese tea gardens, rose gardens, walking trails, California Academy of Sciences. Free parking, bicycle tracks are available, public transport available. A full day visit is recommended.

reviews.title: A Beautiful Park
reviews.text: This is just one amazing park.  It has something for everyone, from the beach/sea end of the park, with the beautiful windmill, to the waterfall, to the side nearer the city with the museum and bandstand.  You can easily spend a whole day exploring it on foot, but would recommend a bike/segway tour through the park as you'll get to explore more of it.

reviews.title: Green Acres
reviews.text: If you enjoy country walks in lovely landscaped surroundings this "city park" is a worthwhile visit which contains themed gardens such as the Japanese Tea Garden which is delightful.The Golden gate park is enourmous with museums and beautifully landscaped gardens well worth a whole day out.Tip : if you are not on a tour ensure that you pre arrange return transport from here...I didnt (assuming I could jump a cab back to Fishermans Wharf.)..believe it or not there is a distinct lack of cabs in this part if town..Still,  the 6 mile trek through the streets of San Francisco added a certain cultural aspect to my trip !

reviews.title: There’s always something to find in the park!
reviews.text: Museums, the roller skaters, the carousel, tai chi lessons, food trucks, Buffalo, impromptu swing dance lessons...there is always something happening in Golden Gate Park. Take a spin around the beautiful Stowe lake or catch a miniature sailboat race at Speckles Lake. Stop in for tea at the Japanese Tea Garden or simply enjoy the flowers at the conservatory.

reviews.title: Nice Garden
reviews.text: It is a nice garden, with Japanise garden as well (9 dollar I think).There is a big museum, you should visit. Great statues as well.

reviews.title: Rose Garden
reviews.text: This Year are wonderful viriety of color, aroma and style! Even smell of fresh apple on some bushes!

reviews.title: One of the great parks in the world
reviews.text: Two great museums incredible Arboretum a wonderful turn of the century hot house as well as huge amounts of hiking and biking trails. Also you have Stowe lake where you can rent paddleboats etc. great views from the top and also great views from the top of the DeYoung museum. Buffaloes anyone?

reviews.title: May 2018
reviews.text: Well a bit disappointed at GGP. We got the Munni to it. Walked through. We did know there are some 'free tours' , but we missed them. You walk through the park we did about 1/3 to 1/2 way. The glass house was shut on the day we went(mon) The Japanese tea garden was $9 each to enter. The technology museum was $36 each. There was another museum of mechines which we didnt bother looking at prices. The Botanical gardens was a charged entrance. So we didnt bother going in any. So caught the Bus to Golden Gate Bridge toll plaza.

reviews.title: Great place to unwind and explore
reviews.text: Wander  through natural settings to enjoy hidden spaces like Angler's  Lodge and Casting Pool and gardens galore. Huge San Francisco treasure!

reviews.title: Great park
reviews.text: Loved walking through this park. Japanese gardens are cool and so is the ocean beach side. Definitely recommend walking all of it.

reviews.title: Jam-packed!
reviews.text: What a park! There is so much in this park, it's a little overwhelming, and I feel that way having only wandered about a third of it. We stopped in over an afternoon and took in a lot of wonderful pathways, a bongo band on hippy hill, amazing miniature tennis players who were crushing it, a roller-skating dance party, four places I hope to return to (I'm talking about conservatories, botanical gardens, art galleries, and science museums!), and a stunning Japanese tea garden. It's definitely a wow-worthy location to spend some time!

reviews.title: Lots to see and do
reviews.text: Such a large well kept park with lots of things to see and do that include the Japanese Tea Gardens, Music Concourse, Dutch Windmill.We went upstairs in the de Young Fine Arts Museum that gives you a birds sure view across the park and parts of the city. Across from the Dutch Windmill was the beach so that was close enough for a walk as well. Take a picnic and spend the day or you can hire a bike and cycle around. Great location to spend a few hours or the whole day.

reviews.title: One of a kind
reviews.text: I love parks and Golden Gate Park is tops. It's so large that there's always something new to discover.

reviews.title: Great park
reviews.text: Great park to wonder around in. There are some nice museums (natural and art) to enjoy, but I didn’t go in them. We walked from the top of the park to the Ocean and it was a great walk. Saw some bison (yes, bison in a park), enjoyed random hiking trails though the trees, and a coffee at the lake on a hill. Totally worth a visit.

reviews.title: Nice addition to the city tours
reviews.text: Recently visited San Francisco and used the 3 day hop on hop off bus pass to see the city. An extra tour included in the ticket took us through Golden Gate Park and went out to Lands End. The shuttle driver was very informative and explained many things about the park which we had no idea of.  The drive to Lands End and along the beachfront was quite scenic as well.

reviews.title: Awesome park
reviews.text: Rented a bike by the park's entrance and enjoyed a long ride through the park. Awesome places to visit and it's possible to visit the Ocean Beach from the west side if the park.Highly recommended.

reviews.title: we loved stow lake and deyoung museum
reviews.text: we loved stow lake and deyoung museum , go early to museum to avoid hordes of people running in all directions , this is a nice place

reviews.title: Lots to see and do!
reviews.text: A Fun place to explore with friends and family. Lots of things to do and see. A quiet place to ease and unwind from the city's hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: So big
reviews.text: We did this on the green trolly from the tourist bus which took us 40 minutes it is such a big park with lots of history

reviews.title: Beautiful Park
reviews.text: Easily the most relaxing part of my trip was walking around this beautiful park. Especially enjoyed the Japanese Tea Garden, we stopped here and enjoyed some delicious snacks and hot tea.

reviews.title: Birthday treat
reviews.text: This ever so peaceful park is well worth a visit. Full of lovely Camelias, great buildings and plenty of photo opportunities to be had here. We visited in the morning and it was very busy but very organised. Spend as little or as long as you like wandering. There is a coffee shop and a chance to buy a trinket or two.

reviews.title: Twin of central Park in New York City
reviews.text: Definitely must see, my first impression was - I feel like in Central Park in NYC. It's really gorgeous, also it's a place where you can escape from all the city noise and chaos. There are a lot things to see, and all these things hide interesting stories about itself, so it's really worth to take a tour as we did. Also, we booked it online via tourscanner.co to check the prices because there may be big differences between operators.

reviews.title: Great for Walking or Running
reviews.text: The golden gate park is a vast park with many roads and trails for all to enjoy as well as the young museum and California science academy. There are bikes and Segways to rent as well as the Japanese tea garden and golf course. There is plenty to do with the entire family. It’s a nice reprieve from the city around you.

reviews.title: Absolutely gorgeous!
reviews.text: My father and I took the Segway tour with the Electric Tour Company (picture below), and our guide, Devin, did an amazing job! We learned a lot about the history of the park and had a fun time doing it! Would highly recommend this park!

reviews.title: Lots to do
reviews.text: We were on tours that went through the park, but didn't stop for any of the activities there. The Japanese Tea Garden and Museum comes highly recommended, but we didn't go there.

reviews.title: Nice park
reviews.text: A great park to walk around and well worth visiting the Japanese Tea garden and also the science museum.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: For those who like to take time and relax or unwind this is the place.  People of all kinds are taking  a relaxing stole through the park taking in nature.  Since the city has so little green space, this is where they love to go and walk, run and bike.  Very relaxing.

reviews.title: Very healthy lifestyle.
reviews.text: Walking into the park, i was greeted with very beautiful flowers such as the cherry blossom! and many other beautiful wild flowers and even lots of ducks! It was so relaxing to stroll and have a picnic. I was also very attracted to the many healthy activities such as skating, volleyball, boat paddling etc! The park is very well maintained!

reviews.title: So much nature.
reviews.text: I walked all the way to Ocean Beach. It was wonderful. All kinds of plants and flowers. Lakes everywhere. Bring water and food because there are only a couple of stands at the beginnings.

reviews.title: Vast space of green
reviews.text: It’s a big park with plenty of space for all sorts of outdoor activities. There are some nice vantage points over entire bay area with nice photo opportunities.

reviews.title: Really pretty
reviews.text: Lovely park- worth a visit. We only walked around the edge really but it is a busy park with runners, dog walkers and people strolling around.

reviews.title: Great park
reviews.text: Had an awesome day at Golden Gate Park. Would definitely recommend the paddle boating at Strawberry Hill and the Japanese tea gardens. Both beautiful areas.Conservatory of Flowers was also nice but quite small for the price.
